_comment: Smoke test for tag embedding injection — 256px, 6 steps, preview at step 4. Same shape as train_smoke.json plus a tag_embed block, so it exercises the extra sequence span, the RowAdamW over the table, and the tag-aware preview. Run: uv run python krea2/train.py krea2/configs/train_tag_smoke.json --parallelism pipeline
_comment_tag_embed: vocab_path is versioned: its row count is baked into the checkpoint and asserted on load, so rebuilding the corpus means tags_v2.parquet and a fresh table. max_tags is free anywhere in 1..256 because the DiT pads the combined sequence to a multiple of 256. tag_drop_prob drops the tag block alone, teaching the model that a caption without tags is still valid; uncond_ratio drops caption AND tags together.

parquet_dataloader._comment_captions: A mixture, not tags-only: the point of the table is that a NATURAL-LANGUAGE caption can arrive with a full tag set attached, which is what forces the tags to carry information the text does not.
parquet_dataloader._comment_tag_column: Decoupled from caption_columns: tags are read from here whichever caption was sampled. Rows without the column (every non-booru source) yield an all-masked block, which is an exact no-op.
